title: Modelled DTP and MCV coverage and zero-dose estimates for Nigeria's LGAs

licence.note: Stated on the WorldPop dataset page. Boundaries were not reviewed separately.

derivation: ADM2_estimates_all_indicators.gpkg and ADM2_zero_dose_estimates.gpkg joined on ID and Year; years 2018, 2021 and 2024 kept; mean, low and up kept; geometry taken once from 2024 and rounded to 6 decimal places.

verification.intervalOrder: low <= mean <= up in every row for all three antigens
verification.nationalTotals: LGA zd_est sums within 0.11% of ADM0 in 2018, 2021 and 2024
verification.ruleCount: 127 LGAs meet the illustrative rule, in the file and on the map

limits: Geospatial covariates were used; which ones was not read.
Coverage intervals are not on the maps.
